t: Amounts authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2013 and available for operation and maintenance for the Air Force as specified in the funding table in section 4301 may be available for the activities of the Commission under this subtitle.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that the mention of a "Commission" signals an advisory body with outside members. But this section only makes Air Force operation and maintenance funds available for the Commission's activities. It does not establish the Commission, describe its membership, or require any consultation, hearing, comment period, or right to sue involving parties outside the federal government.
fable.s: may be available for the activities of the Commission under this subtitle
